units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:1">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>הבא לי ע׳ וכ׳</he> bring me one to go security, and I shall lend thee.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כשאין … הלא הע׳</he> if he has nothing to pay with, who is seized but the surety? <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 8:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. VIII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 6:1">Prov. VI, 1</cite>) <he>בשעה שהזקן … עד שלא נתמנית לא היית ע׳ על וכ׳</he> when a man is appointed an elder, the Lord says to him, before thou wast appointed, thou wast not responsible for the community, now that thou hast been appointed &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:7">B. Bath. X, 7</cite> <he>המלוה … על ידי ע׳ לא יפרע מן הע׳</he> he who loans money to his neighbor through a surety, cannot collect from the surety (before having sued the debtor).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>איזהו ע׳ שהוא חייב וכ׳</he> what guarantor is responsible? He who says, ‘lend him, and I shall pay thee’ (i.e. who guaranteed before the loan was consummated); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרֵבִים</he>, <he>עֲרֵבִין</he>, <cite ref="P01343"><he>עֲרֵי׳</he></cite>. Cant. R. l. c. <he>בשעה שעמדו … הביאו לי ע׳ טובים וכ׳</he> when the Israelites were standing before mount Sinai to receive the Law, the Lord said … bring me good sureties (to vouch for you) that you will guard it; ib. <he>אבותיכם צריכין ע׳</he> your ancestors need sureties themselves; ib. <he>הא ודאי ע׳ וכ׳</he> these (your children) are certainly good sureties, and on their account I will give you the Law; Midr. Till. l. c. Ib. <he>ע׳ אתם על אבותיכם שאם וכ׳</he> will you vouch for your fathers, so that you be seized, if they do not observe the Law? Ib. <he>שהיו ע׳ זה לזה</he> they made themselves responsible for one another.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 27b:19">Snh. 27ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:37">Lev. XXVI, 37</cite>) <he>מלמד שכל ישראל ע׳ זה בזה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שכולן</he>) this intimates that all Israelites are responsible for one another (bound to prevent wrongdoing); <cite ref="Shevuot 39a:22">Shebu. 39ᵃ</cite> bot.; a. fr.
